project_info.theme: Viettel support guidance for fixing one-way SIM lock caused by unverified identity information
project_info.color_palette: Viettel Red, White, Soft Pink, Black

main_subject.detail: A smiling female Viettel support staff member in a red shirt and headset stands on the right making an OK gesture, while the left side contains three white action cards explaining how to complete subscriber identity verification.
main_subject.style: Clean customer-support advertising poster with bright telecom branding, soft blurred background, and friendly human-led assistance tone.

composition_elements.text:
Chưa hoàn thành xác thực thông tin?
"Giải cứu" SIM bị khóa 1 chiều cùng Viettel
Thao tác nhanh vài phút trên My Viettel, Viettel Tammi hoặc VNeID
Tới điểm hỗ trợ xác thực gần nhất
Gọi 1800 8098, bấm phím 0 để đặt lịch phục vụ tận nhà
(Dành cho người cao tuổi, khó khăn đi lại)
viettel telecom
items: Top Left: Large black-and-red headline 'Chưa hoàn thành xác thực thông tin?' with oversized red question mark.
Top Right: Female support agent in red Viettel shirt, headset, glasses, and ID card, posing with an OK hand sign.
Bottom Left: Three stacked rounded white cards with red icon blocks for app verification, nearest support location, and phone booking.
Bottom Right: Agent's torso and hand gesture continue into the lower-right area.
Center/Background: Soft pink-red blurred backdrop with a red pill label '"Giải cứu" SIM bị khóa 1 chiều cùng Viettel'.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft even beauty lighting, clean skin tones, crisp UI-card readability, and gentle backdrop blur.
